blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Cone beam computed tomography (CBCT) is widely used for image guided and adaptive radiotherapy, but scatter, noise, reconstruction artifacts, and inaccurate Hounsfield units limit its quantitative use. Recent diffusion approaches for CBCT to CT synthesis remain largely image driven, with limited use of the underlying acquisition physics. We propose EPC-RawDC, a conditional 3D latent diffusion framework that combines volumetric generative modeling with two complementary constraints derived from the same scanner specific CBCT forward model. First, geometry equivariant projection constraint exploits the rotational equivariance of the CBCT forward operator by supervising the synthesized CT through correspondingly transformed reference projections. Second, raw data consistency uses noisy projection measurements of the individual acquisition as scan specific supervision during training. The framework was evaluated on two independent clinical cohorts with distinct scanner geometries and projection sources. For JUST, the physics constraints used measured clinical raw CBCT projections acquired with an Elekta system, whereas for SynthRAD2025 the projection data were simulated from the reference CT using a Varian geometry with Poisson photon statistics. EPC-RawDC achieved an SSIM of 0.97 in both cohorts and improved PSNR over DDPM by 2.66 dB on SynthRAD2025 and 2.10 dB on JUST, while reducing mean MAE by 20.3% and 19.0%, respectively. On SynthRAD2025, projection consistency and equivariant errors were reduced by 55.0% and 41.4% relative to DDPM. These results demonstrate that combining a volumetric diffusion prior with scanner geometry and scan specific projection measurements improves quantitative CBCT to CT synthesis across both simulated and measured projection domains. Code available after publication at https://github.com/ALZAHRAALTALIB/EPC-RawDC.
blocks.zh: 圆锥束计算成像仪(CBCT)被广泛用于图像引导和适应性放射治疗,但散射、噪音、重建文物和不准确的Hounsfield单元限制了其数量使用。 最近CBCT到CT合成的传播方法在很大程度上仍然是由图像驱动的,对基础获取物理的使用有限. 我们提出EPC-RawDC,这是一个有条件的3D潜在扩散框架,将体积基因模型与来自同一扫描仪特定CBCT前方模型的两个互补限制结合起来。 首先,几何等效投影约束通过通过相应的变换参考预测来监督被合成的CT,利用CBCT前方操作员的旋转等效. 第二,原始数据一致性使用对个人获取的噪音预测测量,作为培训期间的扫描具体监督。 对两个独立的临床组群对该框架进行了评价,这些组群具有独特的扫描仪地缘测量和投影来源。 对于Just来说,所用的物理限制是用一个Elekta系统获得的临床生生CBCT预测,而对于SynthRAD2025来说,投影数据是从参考CT中模拟的,使用了用Poisson光子统计的Varian几何数据。 EPC-RawDC在两个组别中实现了0.97的SSIM,并在SynthRAD2025上的2.66分贝和Just上的2.10分贝上比DDPM改进了PSNR,同时将平均MAE分别减少20.3%和19.0%. 在SynthRAD2025上,相对于DDPM,投影一致性和等效误差分别减少了55.0%和41.4%. 这些结果表明,结合在扫描几何之前的体积扩散和扫描特定投影测量,可以改进CBCT到CT的定量合成,涵盖模拟和被测量的投影领域。 在https://github.com/ALZAHRAALTALIB/EPC-RawDC上公布后可获得代码。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Cone beam computed tomography (CBCT) is widely used for image guidance and adaptive radiotherapy because it provides volumetric information directly at the treatment position. Its quantitative use, however, remains limited by scatter, beam hardening, photon noise, truncation, detector effects, and reconstruction artifacts. These degradations reduce soft tissue contrast and disturb the relationship between reconstructed intensity and tissue attenuation, resulting in inaccurate Hounsfield units (HU) and limiting applications such as dose calculation and online treatment adaptation.
Synthetic CT (sCT) generation from CBCT has therefore become an important approach for obtaining CT like quantitative information from daily treatment imaging. The SynthRAD2025 challenge demonstrated substantial progress in this area using large multicenter datasets, while also showing that image similarity alone does not necessarily predict dosimetric accuracy [ 1 ] . This motivates methods that preserve image quality while incorporating stronger knowledge of the underlying acquisition process.
blocks.zh:
锥束计算成像法(CBCT)被广泛用于图像指导和适应性放射治疗,因为它直接在治疗位置提供体积信息. 然而,其数量用途仍然受到散射、光束硬化、光子噪声、分流、探测器效应和重建文物的限制。 这些降解会降低软组织对比并干扰重建强度与组织衰减之间的关系,导致胡恩斯菲尔德单位(HU)不准确并限制了剂量计算和在线治疗适应等应用.
因此,从CBCT生成合成CT(SCT)已成为从日常治疗成像中获得像定量信息一样的CT的重要方法. SynthRAD2025挑战利用多中心大数据集表明该领域取得了实质性进展,同时也表明,仅凭图像相似性不一定能预测剂量精确度[1]. 这激励了保持图像质量的方法,同时纳入了对基本获取过程的更深入的了解。

blocks.en: Early learning based CBCT to CT methods relied primarily on convolutional networks and generative adversarial models. Cycle consistent architectures enabled unpaired image translation and substantially improved HU accuracy over uncorrected CBCT [ 2 ] , while more recent approaches have incorporated transformer architectures, anatomical constraints, and uncertainty estimation [ 3 ] . Diffusion models have subsequently emerged as a powerful alternative because of their stable denoising objective and ability to model complex conditional image distributions. Peng et al. demonstrated conditional denoising diffusion for CBCT based CT generation with improved image quality and HU fidelity [ 4 ] . More recent studies have explored anatomical guidance, frequency information, patient adaptation, latent representations, and external clinical validation [ 5 ] . 3D latent diffusion has also been investigated for volumetric CBCT to CT synthesis [ 6 ] , while multicenter conditional diffusion studies have shown the feasibility of validation across independent clinical populations [ 7 ] . Consequently, neither latent diffusion nor multicenter evaluation alone constitutes the principal novelty of the present work.
blocks.zh: 早期学习基于CBCT到CT方法,主要依靠演化网络和基因对抗模式. 循环一致的架构使得图像翻译未发酵,比未校正的CBCT[2]大大提高了HU的准确性,而更近期的方法纳入了变压器架构、解剖限制和不确定性估计[3]。 扩散模型后来又被作为强大的替代品而出现,因为它们具有稳定的去诺目标并具有模拟复杂有条件图像分布的能力. 彭等编. 为基于CBCT的CT生成演示了有条件的去名扩散,并改进了图像质量和HU忠心度[4]. 更近期的研究探索了解剖指导,频率信息,患者适应,潜在表达,以及外部临床验证[5]. 3D潜在扩散也被调查了体积CBCT到CT合成[6],而多中心有条件的传播研究表明在独立的临床人群中验证的可行性[7]. 因此,潜在的传播或多中心评价都不是目前工作的主要新内容。

blocks.en: Despite these advances, most CBCT to CT synthesis methods remain predominantly image driven. A generated CT can be anatomically plausible and visually realistic without necessarily satisfying the physical relationships imposed by the CBCT acquisition system or remaining compatible with the projection measurements from which the input CBCT was reconstructed. Latent diffusion provides an efficient mechanism for modeling complete three dimensional volumes [ 8 ] , but the learned generative prior alone does not guarantee consistency with scanner geometry or patient specific measurements. This limitation is particularly relevant to CBCT, where the acquisition trajectory and forward projection model provide strong physical structure that is known independently of the training data.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进步,大多数CBCT到CT合成方法仍然以图像为主. 生成的CT在解剖学上是可信的,在视觉上是现实的,但不一定满足CBCT获取系统施加的物理关系,或与重建CBCT输入的投影测量结果相容. Latent扩散为模拟完整的三维卷[8]提供了高效的机制,但之前的所学基因单是不能保证与扫描仪几何或患者特定测量的一致性. 这一限制与CBCT特别相关,在CBCT中,获取轨迹和前向投影模型提供了独立于培训数据而已知的强大物理结构.

blocks.en:
Equivariance provides one mechanism for incorporating this information. Equivariant imaging demonstrated that symmetries of an imaging operator can constrain learned inverse problems beyond conventional image domain objectives [ 9 ] . In CBCT to CT synthesis, EqDiff-CT introduced rotational equivariance at the network representation level [ 10 ] .
Our previous EPC-3D-Diff framework instead derived a projection domain constraint from the rotational equivariance of the CBCT acquisition operator [ 11 ] . An in plane rotation of the three dimensional object about the scanner axis produces a corresponding angular displacement of its projections. EPC-3D-Diff used this scanner derived transformation law to construct geometry transformed projection supervision within a conditional three dimensional latent diffusion model, rather than generic image domain rotation augmentation.
blocks.zh:
平等是纳入这一信息的一种机制。 等效成像表明,一个成像操作员的对称性可以约束所学到的反向问题,超越了常规成像域目标[9]. 在CBCT到CT合成中,EqDiff-CT在网络代表级别引入了旋转等分[10].
我们之前的EPC-3D-DIff框架相反地从CBCT收购运营商的旋转等同性中衍生出一个投影域限制[11]. 在平面上旋转有关扫描轴的三维天体,产生相应的角移取其预测. EPC-3D-Diff使用这个扫描器衍生出变换定律,在有条件的三维潜在扩散模型中构建几何变换投影监督,而不是通用的图像域旋转增强.

blocks.en: The geometry derived term in EPC-3D-Diff uses a noise free reference projection transformed according to the deterministic symmetry of the scanner operator; it does not incorporate the noisy projection realization measured for an individual scan. The present work addresses this limitation by introducing raw data consistency (RawDC). Both terms use the same scanner specific forward model, but RawDC adds patient and scan specific measurement supervision that is absent from the geometry transformed reference projection term. The acquired photon counts originate from Poisson statistics, while the RawDC objective uses the corresponding post-log quadratic Gaussian approximation developed in Section II-A . Importantly, the implemented forward model preserves scanner specificity by evaluating projections at the native detector resolution of the corresponding acquisition system.
blocks.zh: EPC-3D-Diff中的几何派生术语使用根据扫描器操作员的定型对称性改变的无噪声参考投影;它并不包含为单个扫描所测量的噪音投影实现. 本工作通过采用原始数据一致性(RawDC)来解决这一局限性。 这两个术语都使用同一种扫描仪特定前向模型,但RawDC增加了病人并扫描了几何变形参考投影术语所没有的特定测量监督. 所获取的光子计数来源于Poisson统计,而RawDC目标则使用在第二节-A所开发的相应后日志四相相近. 重要的是,已执行的前沿模型通过在本地探测器分辨率上评价相应购置系统的预测,保留了扫描仪的特异性。

blocks.en: I-A Positioning Against Existing Methods
blocks.zh: I-A 反对现有方法的立场

blocks.en:
Existing CBCT to CT synthesis methods based on GANs, transformers, and conditional diffusion primarily learn image domain mappings [ 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 ] and volumetric latent diffusion improves the efficiency of three dimensional modeling [ 6 ] . Projection consistency has also been incorporated into tomographic reconstruction methods [ 12 , 13 ] , but these approaches reconstruct images directly from projection data rather than perform conditional CBCT to CT synthesis.
EPC-RawDC combines a volumetric latent diffusion prior, geometry transformed projection supervision derived from scanner equivariance, and scan specific raw projection consistency within a single synthesis framework.
blocks.zh:
现有的CBCT到CT基于GANs的合成方法,变压器,以及有条件的传播主要学习图像域映射[2,3,4,5],而体积潜在传播可以提高三维模型的效率[6]. 投影一致性也被纳入了图象重建方法[12,13]中,但这些方法直接从投影数据重建图像,而不是进行有条件的CBCT到CT合成.
EPC-RawDC结合了由扫描仪等效而得到的量子潜在扩散前几何变形投影监督,并在单一合成框架内扫描出具体的原始投影一致性.

blocks.en: Relative to EqDiff and EPC-3D-Diff [ 10 , 11 ] , the present work introduces scan specific raw data consistency that directly constrains the synthesized CT using the projection measurements of the corresponding acquisition.
blocks.zh: 相对于EqDiff和EPC-3D-Diff[10,11],本作引入了特定的原始数据一致性扫描,使用相应的获取的投影测量直接限制被合成的CT.

blocks.en: I-B Main Contributions
blocks.zh: 主要捐款

blocks.en: The principal novelty of EPC-RawDC is the integration of an equivariance derived projection constraint with scan specific raw projection consistency within a common acquisition CBCT forward model for the conditional 3D latent diffusion.
blocks.zh: EPC-RawDC的主要新颖之处是,将等效衍生投影约束与扫描特定原始投影一致性结合起来,在有条件的3D潜在扩散的共同获取CBCT前行模型中进行扫描.

blocks.en:
The contributions are threefold. First, we formulate conditional 3D latent diffusion for volumetric CBCT to CT synthesis.
Second, we impose geometry transformed projection supervision using the physical relationship between object rotation and projection angle shift induced by the scanner operator. Third, RawDC constrains the predicted CT during training using the projection measurements of the corresponding acquisition. Both physics terms use the same acquisition faithful forward operator while encoding complementary reference geometry and scan specific measurement information. The framework is evaluated on independent datasets with distinct scanner geometries using controlled ablations of volumetric diffusion, geometry derived projection supervision, and raw data consistency.
blocks.zh:
捐款额为三分之一。 首先,我们提出有条件的 三维潜在扩散 为体积CBCT 到CT合成。
第二,我们利用由扫描仪操作员诱导的物体自转和投影角度移之间的物理关系,实行几何变形投影监督. 第三,RawDC利用对相应购置的预测测量,在培训期间限制预测的CT。 两个物理术语都使用同一种获取忠实的前向操作器,同时编码互补的参考几何并扫描特定的测量信息. 该框架在独立的数据集上加以评价,这些数据集采用不同的扫描仪,采用控制卷片扩散、几何衍生投影监督以及原始数据一致性。

blocks.en: Together, these contributions establish EPC-RawDC as a measurement grounded generative framework in which the sCT is constrained jointly by the learned CT distribution, the known scanner geometry, and the projection measurements of the individual acquisition.
blocks.zh: 这些贡献共同建立了EPC-RawDC,作为基于测量的基因框架,其中SCT受到所学CT分布、已知的扫描器几何学以及个人获取的投影测量的共同制约.

blocks.en: II-B CBCT Geometry Induced Projection Equivariance
blocks.zh: II-B CBCT 几何导射等效

blocks.en: Equivariance in the proposed framework is not introduced as a generic image augmentation prior. Instead, it follows directly from the rotational symmetry of the CBCT acquisition geometry. In a circular CBCT scan, the X-ray source and detector rotate around a fixed scanner axis while maintaining their relative source, isocenter, and detector geometry [ 9 ] . Consequently, rotating the object around the axis produces an equivalent angular displacement of its projection data.
blocks.zh: 拟议框架的等同性不是作为一般图像增强的先入之出。 相反,它直接来自于CBCT获取几何的旋转对称. 在CBCT环形扫描中,X射线源和探测器在固定扫描器轴上旋转,同时保持相对源,异位,和探测器几何[9]. 因此,围绕轴旋转物体产生其预测数据等同角移位.

blocks.en: IV-A SynthRAD2025 Cohort
blocks.zh: 四-A 合成雷达2025 组合

blocks.en: SynthRAD2025 provides multicenter clinical CT and CBCT data for synthetic CT generation in radiotherapy [ 17 ] . Because raw projection measurements are not distributed with the dataset, the reference CT volumes were used to generate a controlled CBCT acquisition domain using a Varian cone beam geometry. The scanner forward operator was implemented with the ASTRA Toolbox [ 18 ] . Projection measurements were generated from the CT attenuation volumes using Poisson photon statistics with an incident fluence of I 0 = 10 4 I_{0}=10^{4} photons per ray, followed by FDK reconstruction. The native simulated detector consisted of 768 × 1024 768\times 1024 elements.
blocks.zh: SynthRAD2025提供多中心临床CT和CBCT数据,用于放射治疗中合成CT生成[17]. 由于原始投影测量不与数据集相分配,参考CT卷被用来用Varian Cone Beam几何来生成受控CBCT获取域. 扫描器前方操作员与ASTRA工具箱相接 [18]. 利用Poisson光子统计数据从CT衰减量中产生出预测量,事件流出量为I 0 = 10 4 I_{0}=10^{4}光子每射线,然后FDK重建. 本土模拟探测器由768×1024 768\times 1024元素组成.

blocks.en: IV-B JUST Clinical Cohort
blocks.zh: IV-B 刚刚临床合唱团

blocks.en:
The JUST cohort consists of paired clinical CT and CBCT examinations acquired at King Abdullah University Hospital, Jordan, with ethical approval Mar2026/191-38. In contrast to SynthRAD2025, the projection measurements used for the physics constraints were obtained from the clinical raw CBCT data. Therefore, the noise characteristics of the measured acquisition were retained.
The corresponding Elekta acquisition model contains 220 projection views and a native 512 × 512 512\times 512 detector.
The ASTRA Toolbox was used to implement the scanner specific forward operator employed by the geometry derived projection and RawDC constraints. The paired JUST CT and CBCT volumes were spatially aligned and resampled to the same grid to ensure voxelwise correspondence. Using a common image representation, while retaining the corresponding Varian and Elekta forward operators, allowed the same 3D diffusion architecture to be evaluated across both cohorts, without removing differences in scanner acquisition physics.
blocks.zh:
JUST组由在约旦阿卜杜拉国王大学医院获得的对等临床CT和CBCT检查组成,伦理学批准为Mar2026/191-38。 与SynthRAD2025相比,用于物理约束的预测测量数据取自临床原始CBCT数据. 因此,保留了所计量购置的噪音特性。
相应的"Elekta"收购模型包含220个投影视图和一个原生的512×512 512\times 512探测器.
ASTRA工具箱被用于执行几何派生投影和RawDC限制所使用的扫描仪特定前方操作员。 成对的Just CT和CBCT卷在空间上对齐并重印到同一个网格上,以确保阴道相通. 使用共同的图像表示,虽然保留了相应的Varian和Elekta前置操作器,但允许在两个组别中评价相同的3D扩散架构,同时没有去除扫描仪获取物理中的区别.

blocks.en: V-A Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 五-A 执行详情

blocks.en: The same network and optimization configuration was used for SynthRAD2025 and JUST, with the dataset and scanner specific geometry changed accordingly. Input volumes were encoded into 4 channel latent representations of size 4 × 50 × 128 × 128 4\times 50\times 128\times 128 , preserving the complete through plane dimension. The pretrained encoder and decoder, implemented with 4 latent, 32 hidden channels and 500 epochs, were fixed during diffusion training. The conditional 3D UNet used 64 base channels and a 256 dimensional sinusoidal time embedding. Diffusion was performed over 1000 1000 time steps using a linear variance schedule from β 1 = 10 − 4 \beta_{1}=10^{-4} to β T = 5 × 10 − 3 \beta_{T}=5\times 10^{-3} . Training used Adam with a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} and batch size one. The rotational projection constraint used one randomly signed rotation of 2 ∘ 2^{\circ} – 10 ∘ 10^{\circ} . Validation sampling used a 100 step DDIM procedure.

blocks.en: V-B Single Domain Performance and Component Ablation
blocks.zh: V-B 单域性能和组件偏差

blocks.en: We first evaluated all methods in the single domain setting, where training and testing were performed on the same clinical cohort using the same CBCT acquisition geometry. This experiment assesses reconstruction performance before introducing scanner or domain mismatch.
blocks.zh: 我们首先评价了单一域内的所有方法,即使用同样的CBCT获取几何学对同一个临床群体进行培训和测试。 这一实验在引入扫描仪或域错配之前评估了重建性能.

blocks.en: For the JUST cohort, the models were trained using the Elekta acquisition geometry and evaluated on eight independent patients that were not included during training. For SynthRAD2025, training and testing were performed using the corresponding acquisition setting, with 24 independent patients included in the final evaluation. In both cohorts, the data split was defined at the patient level to prevent information leakage between training and testing.
blocks.zh: 对JUST群体来说,这些模型是使用Elekta获得几何学进行训练的,并对8名独立病人进行了评价,这些病人在训练期间没有包括在内。 就SynthRAD2025而言,培训和测试是使用相应的购置设置进行的,最终评价中包括24名独立的病人。 在这两个组别中,数据分割是在病人一级界定的,以防止培训与测试之间的信息泄漏。

blocks.en:
The ablation study included four diffusion based variants: DDPM [ 4 ] , EPC-3D-Diff [ 11 ] , RawDC and the complete EPC-RawDC model. The comparison models included a volumetric residual UNet (3D ResUNet), implemented as a 3D extension of residual UNet architectures previously investigated for CBCT based synthetic CT generation [ 19 ] .
A volumetric CycleGAN was also implemented using 3D convolutional generators and discriminators, consistent with recent applications in medical image synthesis [ 20 ] .
blocks.zh:
通缩研究包括了四个基于扩散的变体: DDPM [4], EPC-3D-Diff [11], RawDC和完整的EPC-RawDC模型. 比较模型包括一个积分残存的UNet(3D ResUNet),作为先前为CBCT合成CT生成所调查的残存UNet架构的3D扩展而执行. [19].
体积循环 GAN也使用3D回旋相机和歧义相机实施,这与医学图像合成的最新应用相符合. [20].

blocks.en: Table II summarizes the patient level quantitative results for both cohorts. All synthesis methods substantially improved the input CBCT, with the physics informed diffusion variants showing the strongest overall performance. EPC-3D-Diff and RawDC both improved upon DDPM, indicating that geometry derived reference projection supervision and scan specific projection supervision each contribute to reconstruction quality. Their combination in EPC-RawDC provided the best overall results in both datasets, reaching an SSIM of 0.97 0.97 in both cohorts and the highest PSNR of 39.18 39.18 dB for SynthRAD2025 and 38.00 38.00 dB for JUST. Compared with DDPM, EPC-RawDC reduced the mean MAE by approximately 20.3 % 20.3\% for SynthRAD2025 and 19.0 % 19.0\% for JUST.
blocks.zh: 表二汇总了两个组群的患者水平量化结果。 所有合成方法都大大改进了输入CBCT,物理知情的传播变体显示出最强的整体性能. EPC-3D-Diff和RawDC均在DDPM上有所改进,表明几何学派生出参考投影监督并扫描出具体的投影监督,都有助于重建质量. 它们在EPC-RawDC的组合为两个数据集提供了最佳的总体结果,两个组群的SSIM都达到0.97 0.97,Just的PSNR最高为39.18 39.18 dB为SynthRAD2025和38.00 38.00 dB为Just. 与DDPM相比,EPC-RawDC将SynthRAD2025的平均MAE减少了约20.3%,Just减少了19.0%。

blocks.en: The comparison models also improved substantially over the input CBCT, but their overall performance remained below EPC-RawDC. Across both datasets, EPC-RawDC achieved higher PSNR and lower MAE than 3D UNet and 3D CycleGAN, while also providing the highest SSIM. The consistent behaviour across SynthRAD2025 and JUST suggests that the benefit of combining equivariant projection supervision with RawDC is maintained across both acquisition settings.
blocks.zh: 比较模型也大大改进了CBCT的投入,但其总体性能仍然低于EPC-RawDC. 在两个数据集中,EPC-RawDC实现了比3D UNet和3D CycleGAN更高的PSNR和较低的MAE,同时也提供了最高的SSIM. 整个SynthRAD2025和Just的一贯行为表明,将等效投影监督与RawDC相结合的好处在两种购置环境都得到保持。

blocks.en: These findings support the complementary use of the two projection domain terms. EPC-3D-Diff uses geometry transformed supervision from the reference CT, whereas RawDC uses the projection measurements of the acquisition. Their combination produced the best mean performance, although the patient level analysis below shows that some incremental differences relative to RawDC were not statistically significant.
blocks.zh: 这些结论支持两个预测域名的补充使用。 EPC-3D-diff使用从参考CT中转换出几何导体,而RawDC则使用获取的预测测量. 虽然下文的病人水平分析显示,相对于RawDC而言,一些递增差异在统计学上并不显著,但两者的结合产生了最优的平均表现。

blocks.en:
Figure 2 presents representative axial examples from the JUST and SynthRAD2025 test cohorts. For each case, the reference CT, input CBCT, synthesized CT images, and absolute error maps are shown. The examples illustrate reconstruction behaviour in soft tissue, bone, air cavities, and regions affected by CBCT intensity artifacts. Images are displayed using both the full HU range [ − 1000 , 2000 ] [-1000,2000] HU and the soft tissue range [ − 160,240 ] [-160,240] HU.
The full HU range provides an overall view of the reconstructed anatomy, whereas the soft tissue window enhances smaller intensity differences. MAE values computed within these windows are therefore not directly comparable, as the full HU range spans substantially larger intensity variations.

图2列出了JUST和SynthRAD2025测试组群中具有代表性的轴向实例。 每个案例都显示参考CT,输入CBCT,合成CT图像,绝对出错地图. 这些例子说明了软组织、骨骼、空气腔和受CBCT强度文物影响的地区的重建行为。 图像的显示使用全HU范围[−1000,2000] [1000,2000] HU和软组织范围[−160,240] [-160,240] HU.
完整的HU范围为被重建的解剖学提供了总体视角,而软组织窗口则会增强较小的强度差异. 因此,在这些窗口内计算出的MAE值不具有直接可比性,因为整个HU范围的强度变化要大得多。

blocks.en: V-C Cross Dataset Generalization under Fixed Geometry
blocks.zh: V-C 固定几何下的交叉数据集概论

blocks.en: Cross dataset generalization was evaluated in both transfer directions while preserving the acquisition geometry used during training. The model trained on SynthRAD2025 with the Varian geometry was evaluated on 8 subjects from JUST dataset represented using the same Varian forward model, whereas the model trained on JUST with the Elekta geometry was evaluated on 24 SynthRAD2025 patients represented using the corresponding Elekta forward model. The results are reported in Tables III and IV .
blocks.zh: 交叉数据集一般化在两个传输方向都得到了评价,同时保留了培训期间使用的获取几何学。 在Varian几何学上接受过SynthRAD2025培训的模型,在使用同一Varian前向模型代表的JUST数据集的8个课题上得到了评价,而在使用Elekta几何学上接受过JUST培训的模型,在使用相应的Elekta前向模型代表的24名SynthRAD2025患者上得到了评价。 调查结果见表三和表四。

blocks.en: For transfer from SynthRAD2025 to JUST, EPC-RawDC showed a clear improvement over DDPM, increasing SSIM by approximately 5.7 % 5.7\% , increasing PSNR by 1.32 1.32 dB, and reducing MAE by 23.7 % 23.7\% . Relative to RawDC, EPC-RawDC maintained the same SSIM at the reported precision, while improving PSNR by 0.47 0.47 dB and reducing MAE by approximately 5.6 % 5.6\% . This indicates that the combined constraints remained beneficial when the model was applied to an independent clinical population.
blocks.zh: 从SynthRAD2025转至Just,EPC-RawDC比DDPM明显改善,SSIM增加了约5.7% 5.7 % , PSNR增加了1.32 1.32 dB, MAE减少了23.7% 23.7 % 。 EPC-RawDC与RawDC相比,保持了相同的SSIM的精确度,同时PSNR改进了0.47 0.47 dB, MAE减少了约5.6% 5.6 % 。 这表明,当该模型适用于独立的临床人群时,综合制约因素仍然有益。

blocks.en: The reverse transfer from JUST to SynthRAD2025 showed the same overall trend, although the improvement was smaller. Compared with DDPM, EPC-RawDC increased SSIM by approximately 5.6 % 5.6\% and reduced MAE by 6.8 % 6.8\% , while PSNR increased by 0.04 0.04 dB. Compared with RawDC, EPC-RawDC further improved SSIM by approximately 1.1 % 1.1\% and reduced MAE by 2.5 % 2.5\% . The consistent performance in both transfer directions suggests that the physics constrained framework improves robustness to changes in patient population while the CBCT forward geometry is maintained.
blocks.zh: 从Just到SynthRAD2025的反向转移也显示出同样的总体趋势,尽管改进较小. 与DDPM相比,EPC-RawDC将SSIM增加了约5.6% 5.6\%,将MAE减少了6.8% 6.8\%;而PSNR则增加了0.040.04分贝. 与RawDC相比,EPC-RawDC进一步将SSIM改进了约1.1 % 1.1 % ,并将MAE减少2.5% 2.5 % . 两个转接方向的一致性能表明,物理受限框架在保持CBCT前方几何学的同时,提高了病人人口变化的稳健性.

blocks.en: V-D Joint Multi Domain Training
blocks.zh: V-D 多领域联合培训

blocks.en:
To assess whether a single model could accommodate heterogeneous acquisition physics, EPC-RawDC was trained jointly using the SynthRAD2025 and JUST cohorts, with each sample retaining its corresponding scanner specific forward operator.
The shared model was then evaluated independently on the held out test cohort from each domain.
blocks.zh:
为了评估单一的模型是否能够容纳不同的获取物理学,EPC-RawDC使用SynthRAD2025和JUST组群联合培训,每个样本保留了相应的扫描仪特定的前向操作员。
然后,对每个领域的测试组进行独立评估。

blocks.en: As shown in Table V , EPC-RawDC consistently improved upon DDPM after joint training. On SynthRAD2025, EPC-RawDC increased SSIM by approximately 1.1 % 1.1\% , improved PSNR by 0.49 0.49 dB, and reduced MAE by 6.5 % 6.5\% . A similar trend was observed on JUST, where SSIM increased by approximately 1.1 % 1.1\% , PSNR improved by 0.35 0.35 dB, and MAE decreased by 5.8 % 5.8\% .

blocks.en: V-E Volumetric 3D Versus Slice Wise 2D Modeling
blocks.zh: V-E 卷曲 3D Versus 智取 二D 建模

blocks.en: The contribution of volumetric context was evaluated by comparing the proposed 3D framework with corresponding slice wise 2D synthesis methods. The 2D EqDiff model employs rotational equivariance directly in the image domain through a C 4 C_{4} group equivariant denoising network [ 10 ] , whereas EPC-3D-Diff uses translated projection supervision derived from image rotational equivariance of the CBCT forward operator within a volumetric latent diffusion framework [ 11 ] . EPC-RawDC further incorporates patient specific projection consistency into the 3D formulation.

blocks.en: Overall, the patient level analysis confirms that the improvement over the unconstrained DDPM baseline is highly consistent across subjects. The smaller differences relative to EPC-3D-Diff and RawDC indicate that the incremental benefit of combining equivariant projection supervision with raw data consistency is most evident in structural similarity and, for the JUST cohort, in absolute intensity accuracy.

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六. 结论

blocks.en:
This work introduced EPC-RawDC, a conditional 3D latent diffusion framework that integrates equivariance derived projection supervision with raw data consistency through a common acquisition CBCT forward operator. Across SynthRAD2025 and JUST, EPC-RawDC provided the best mean performance among the evaluated diffusion and comparison methods, reducing MAE relative to DDPM by 20.3% and 19.0%, respectively. Direct physics evaluation further demonstrated improved agreement with the projection measurements and geometry transformed reference projections.
Cross dataset, joint domain, and volumetric experiments further characterized the generalization and multi domain behaviour of the framework, while domain specific training remained advantageous for quantitative accuracy.
These findings support measurement grounded diffusion as a promising approach for quantitative CBCT to CT synthesis. Future work will investigate broader multicenter validation and the impact of the synthesized CT on downstream radiotherapy tasks, including dose calculation and adaptive treatment workflows.
blocks.zh:
这项工作引入了EPC-RawDC,这是一个有条件的3D潜在扩散框架,通过一个共同的CBCT前置操作员,将等效衍生投影监督与原始数据一致性结合起来。 在整个SynthRAD2025和Just, EPC-RawDC在所评价的传播和比较方法中提供了最好的平均性能,比DDPM分别减少了20.3%和19.0%。 直接物理评价进一步表明,对预测测量和几何变化参考预测有更好的一致。
交叉数据集,联合域和量子实验进一步定性为框架的通称和多域行为,而特定域培训仍然有利于量化准确性.
这些结论支持基于计量的传播,认为是量化的CBCT到CT综合的有希望的方法. 今后的工作将调查更广泛的多中心验证以及综合CT对下游放射治疗任务的影响,包括剂量计算和适应性治疗工作流程。
